reason: Generates, saves, verifies, and optionally publishes work reports derived from DeepSeek Harness session logs, making document processing the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的任务、统计、工具调用和产出整理为可保存、可验证并可选发布的日报、周报、交接文档或文章草稿。
summaries.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness session activity into savable and verifiable daily, weekly, handoff, or article report drafts, with optional publishing to Feishu or Notion.

capabilities: Reads current and historical DeepSeek Harness session logs
Generates daily, weekly, handoff, and article report drafts
Writes Markdown or HTML reports and receipt metadata to workspace paths
Computes SHA-256 hashes for reports and selected artifacts
Publishes report content to Feishu or Notion when configured
